verdict.rationale: dlt has a documented CLI (dlt-docs-10, dlt-docs-82, dlt-probe-5) for scaffolding/inspecting/deploying pipelines, a Python API (pipeline.run, dlt.pipeline) for headless execution, and dltHub explicitly ships an 'AI Harness' plus MCP servers/skills teaching coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to scaffold, build, deploy, and run production pipelines end-to-end (dlt-docs-13, dlt-docs-14, dlt-docs-44, dlt-docs-58, dlt-docs-69), corroborated by a real MCP server card and agent-skills manifest (dlt-docs-47, dlt-docs-48, dlt-probe-4). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party evidence of an agent actually completing this workflow end-to-end (only vendor docs and a separate MCP server repo, no community confirmation of headless agent-driven scaffolding).
